title: Import owned characters from HoYoLAB
intro: Imports the weapons, artifacts, talent levels and more of your owned characters from your HoYoLAB Battle Chronicle, so you can use them in the party settings. The imported data is stored only in this browser and is not sent to the operator's servers.

ext.updateTitle: A newer version of the extension is available (installed: v{{installed}} → latest: v{{latest}})
ext.updateBody: With an older version, some features may not work (for example, some characters may not be imported). Please update with the steps below.
ext.note: The extension communicates only with HoYoLAB (hoyolab.com) and Enka.Network (enka.network, an unofficial service). Communication with Enka.Network for your own UID can be turned off with the checkbox below. Neither the extension nor this app reads the value of your login information (cookies).

install.intro: Install the extension in Chrome in 5 steps (only once; about 3-5 minutes).
install.s1Body: Download the extension zip file with the button below.
install.s2Body: Right-click the downloaded zip and choose "Extract All". Extract it to a place you will not delete, such as Documents.
install.s2Note: Chrome keeps using this extracted folder after installation. Do not delete or move it.
install.s3Body: Press the button below. An empty new tab opens and the address of the extensions page is copied. Click the address bar of the new tab, paste (Ctrl+V) and press Enter. When the extensions page opens, turn on "Developer mode" at the top right.
install.s3Button: Open a new tab and copy {{address}}
install.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Please copy this address yourself (select the text and press Ctrl+C) and paste it into the address bar of the new tab: {{address}}
install.s4Body: Click "Load unpacked" at the top left and choose the folder you extracted in step 2 (the one that contains manifest.json). It worked if "Genshin Rotation Planner - HoYoLAB import" appears in the list.
install.s5Body: Reload with the button below, then open "Import Chars" again. If "Extension detected" appears, you are done.
install.trouble1: Still "Extension not found": check that you reloaded in step 5 and that the extension switch is on in the extensions page.
install.trouble2: "Manifest file is missing": if there is another folder with the same name inside the extracted folder, choose the inner one.
install.trouble3: "This extension is disabled" (for example after restarting Chrome): turn the switch on again in the extensions page.
install.trouble4: Edge works the same way (address: edge://extensions), but it has only been tested in Chrome.
install.update: To update (no need to remove and reinstall): extract the new zip over the same folder as before, then press the "Reload" (circular arrow) button on this extension's card in the extensions page. If you extracted to a different folder, remove the old extension and load the new folder.

uid.label: Genshin UID
uid.loginHint: Before importing, log in to HoYoLAB in this browser. You cannot import without logging in.
uid.hint: For the UID of the account you are logged in with, all characters are imported even if the HoYoLAB "Character Details" privacy setting is off. For another account's UID, HoYoLAB does not provide the details, so only the characters that account has placed in its in-game "Character Showcase" are imported from Enka.Network (an unofficial service). HoYoLAB can lag behind equipment changes made in game (even 30 minutes after logging out), so the characters (up to 12) placed in the in-game "Character Showcase" are overwritten with the latest values from Enka.Network (log out of the game before importing). Characters not in the showcase keep their HoYoLAB values. Importing again replaces the previous import.
uid.useEnka: Overwrite the in-game Character Showcase characters with the latest values from Enka.Network
uid.useEnkaHint: When on, the UID is sent to enka.network (an unofficial service) to get the latest equipment. When off, only the HoYoLAB values are used and enka.network is not contacted. UIDs of other accounts and of the China servers can only be imported through Enka.Network, so it is used even when this is off.

import.donePartial: {{count}} characters imported (only the characters the owner has made public; {{skipped}} could not be fetched)
import.doneEnka: {{count}} characters imported (because this is another account's UID, only the characters shown in its in-game "Character Showcase" were imported from Enka.Network)
import.enkaEmpty: HoYoLAB does not provide character details for other accounts. On Enka.Network, that account has no characters in its "Character Showcase", so there was nothing to import (the owner needs to place characters in the in-game profile showcase).
import.enkaNeedUpdate: Importing another account's UID requires extension v{{version}} or later. Please update the extension (see the steps above).
import.errorPrivate: Could not get the Battle Chronicle. Check that the UID you entered belongs to the account you are logged in with. The UID of another account can only be imported if its owner has made the Battle Chronicle public ({{message}})
import.errorLogin: You are not logged in to HoYoLAB. Log in to HoYoLAB in this browser ({{message}})
import.enkaMerged: Updated {{updated}} characters to their latest values from the in-game Character Showcase via Enka.Network ({{added}} added, {{skipped}} not updated because incomplete). The other {{rest}} keep their HoYoLAB values (HoYoLAB can lag behind equipment changes made in game).
import.enkaFailedKept: Could not update from Enka.Network ({{message}}). Saved with the HoYoLAB values.
import.enkaEmptyKept: No Character Showcase characters were found on Enka.Network, so the HoYoLAB values were saved.
import.enkaSkippedOldExt: The extension is too old (v{{version}} or newer is needed for Enka.Network), so the HoYoLAB values were saved.
import.enkaOff: The Enka.Network overwrite was skipped because the checkbox is off (saved with the HoYoLAB values).
import.timedOut: The extension did not respond in time. Check that it is installed, and try again in a while (HoYoLAB or Enka.Network may be busy).

update.intro: Update in 5 steps (no need to remove and reinstall).
update.s2Body: Extract the downloaded zip to the same folder as before and overwrite the files with the same names (right-click > Extract All, and choose the previous folder).
update.s2Note: If you extracted to a different folder, in step 4 remove the old extension and load the new folder again.
update.s3Body: Press the button below to open a blank new tab and copy the extensions page address. Paste it into the address bar of the opened tab (Ctrl+V) and press Enter.
update.s4Body: On the card of "Genshin Rotation Planner - HoYoLAB Importer", press the "Reload" (circular arrow) button. The version is updated.
update.s5Body: Press the button below to reload, then open "Import owned characters" again. If the version shown in "Extension detected" is the new one, the update is complete.

installFx.intro: Install the extension in Firefox in 3 steps (only once; about 1-2 minutes; Firefox 140 or later).
installFx.s1Body: Download the extension file (.xpi) with the button below.
installFx.s1Note: If Firefox asks to install it right after the download, press "Add" and you are done (step 2 is not needed).
installFx.s2Title: Install the file from the Firefox add-ons page
installFx.s2Body: Press the button below. An empty new tab opens and the address of the add-ons page is copied. Click the address bar of the new tab, paste (Ctrl+V) and press Enter. On the add-ons page, click the gear (⚙) → "Install Add-on From File", choose the downloaded .xpi, and press "Add" in the confirmation.
installFx.s2Note: You can also drag the downloaded file onto the Firefox window to install it.
installFx.trouble1: Still "Extension not found": check that you reloaded in step 3 and that the extension is enabled (switch on) in the add-ons page. Also check, in the extension's details under "Permissions", that access to the site is allowed.
installFx.trouble2: The extension may not run in a private window. In the add-ons page, open this extension's details and allow "Run in Private Windows".
installFx.trouble3: "Could not be added" or similar: Firefox older than 140 cannot install it. Please update Firefox. If it still fails, try again with a freshly downloaded file (button above).
installFx.update: To update: Firefox updates the extension automatically (it checks about once a day). To update right away, click the gear (⚙) on the add-ons page → "Check for Updates", then reload this page.

updateFx.intro: Firefox updates the extension automatically (it checks about once a day). To update right away, follow these 3 steps.
updateFx.s1Body: Press the button below to open an empty new tab and copy the address of the add-ons page. Paste it into the address bar of the opened tab (Ctrl+V) and press Enter.
updateFx.s2Body: On the add-ons page, click the gear (⚙) → "Check for Updates". After a moment, the version of "Genshin Rotation Planner - HoYoLAB Importer" is updated.
updateFx.s2Note: If it is not updated automatically, download the new file (.xpi) with the button below and install it again with the gear (⚙) → "Install Add-on From File" (it is updated in place).

blocked.otherTitle: Owned characters cannot be imported in this browser
blocked.otherBody: Importing needs the extension, and the extension can only be installed in desktop Chrome-based browsers (Chrome, Edge, etc.) and Firefox. It cannot be installed on smartphones, tablets, Safari and other browsers. Please open this page again in desktop Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
blocked.oldFirefoxTitle: Owned characters cannot be imported in your Firefox (version {{major}})
blocked.oldFirefoxBody: The extension needs Firefox {{min}} or later. Please update Firefox and open this page again.
blocked.oldChromiumTitle: Owned characters cannot be imported in your browser (version {{major}})
blocked.oldChromiumBody: The extension needs Chrome {{min}} or later (the same standard applies to Chrome-based browsers such as Edge). Please update the browser and open this page again.
